message.reasoning:
We need to generate a JUnit 4 test file for SerializationException. Tests should cover constructors, message, cause, inheritance, behavior. Use assertions. Provide file with marker lines. Should import org.junit.*; and static org.junit.Assert.*. Also test that it's unchecked (extends RuntimeException). Ensure serialization exception's message handling: with null, non-null, cause. Also test that cause can be retrieved. Perhaps test that super constructors behave as per RuntimeException: getMessage returns as passed; when cause passed only, message is cause.toString(); when both, message is as passed. Also test that default constructor has null message and cause. Also test that subclass cannot be extended (final). That's compile-time, can't test at runtime. But can use reflection to ensure class is final.

Write tests: testDefaultConstructor, testMessageConstructor, testCauseConstructor, testMessageAndCauseConstructor, testClassIsFinal, testInheritance.

Will use JUnit 4 annotations @Test.

Add import java.io.IOException.

Make test class in same package org.jsoup (or maybe different). Should be in same package to access package-private? class is public, so fine.

Add @RunWith(JUnit4.class) optional.

Add test methods.

Edge cases: message null, cause null.

Test cause constructor: when cause is null, getCause returns null, message is null (since super(cause) in Throwable sets message to cause==null? Actually Throwable(Throwable cause) constructor sets cause and message = (cause==null ? null : cause.toString()). So message should be null if cause null. We'll assert that.

Test cause non-null: use IOException with message "IO error". Expect getCause returns same, getMessage equals cause.toString() (which includes class name and message). We'll assert.

Message constructor with null message: getMessage null.

Message and cause both null: both null.

Message non-null, cause non-null: getMessage returns given message, cause returns given cause.

Test inheritance: instanceof RuntimeException, etc.

Ok produce file. Ensure markers.
